mn37:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde.
mn37:2.1: atha kho sakko devānamindo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho sakko devānamindo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn37:2.2: “kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhu saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti accantaniṭṭho accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānanti.”
mn37:3.3: evañca taṃ devānaminda bhikkhuno sutaṃ hoti:
mn37:3.5: so sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānāti. sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya sabbaṃ dhammaṃ parijānāti. sabbaṃ dhammaṃ pariññāya yaṃ kiñci vedanaṃ vedeti
mn37:3.6: sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, so tāsu vedanāsu aniccānupassī viharati, virāgānupassī viharati, nirodhānupassī viharati, paṭinissaggānupassī viharati.
mn37:3.7: so tāsu vedanāsu aniccānupassī viharanto, virāgānupassī viharanto, nirodhānupassī viharanto, paṭinissaggānupassī viharanto na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
mn37:3.8: anupādiyaṃ na paritassati. aparitassaṃ paccattaññeva parinibbāyati.
mn37:3.9: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāti.
mn37:3.10: ettāvatā kho devānaminda bhikkhu saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti accantaniṭṭho accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānanti.
mn37:4.1: atha kho sakko devānamindo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
mn37:5.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti.
mn37:5.3: ‘kinnu kho so yakkho bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhisamecca anumodi, udāhu no.
mn37:5.5: yadivā so yakkho bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhisamecca anumodi, yadivā no’ti.
mn37:6.1: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evamevaṃ pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde antarahito devesu tāvatiṃsesu pāturahosi.
mn37:7.1: tena kho pana samayena sakko devānamindo ekapuṇḍarīke uyyāne dibbehi pañcahi tūriyasatehi samappito samaṅgībhūto paricāreti.
mn37:7.2: addasā kho sakko devānamindo āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
mn37:7.3: disvāna tāni dibbāni pañca turiyasatāni paṭippaṇāmetvā yenāyasmā mahāmoggallāno tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ etadavoca:
mn37:7.4: ehi kho mārisa moggallāna, sāgataṃ mārisa moggallāna.
mn37:7.5: cirassaṃ kho mārisa moggallāna, imaṃ pariyāyamakāsi yadidaṃ idhāgamanāya.
mn37:7.7: nisīdi kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno paññatte āsane.
mn37:7.8: sakkopi kho devānamindo aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn37:7.9: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ āyasmā mahāmoggallāno etadavoca:
mn37:8.1: yathākathaṃ pana te kosiya bhagavā saṅkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiṃ abhāsi?
mn37:8.2: sādhu mayampi etissā kathāya bhāgino assāma savanāyāti.
mn37:8.3: “mayaṃ kho mārisa moggallāna bahukiccā, mayaṃ bahukaraṇīyā,
mn37:8.4: appeva sakena karaṇīyena, apica devānaṃyeva tāvatiṃsānaṃ karaṇīyena.
mn37:8.5: apica mārisa moggallāna, sussutaṃyeva hoti suggahītaṃ sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritaṃ yaṃ no khippameva antaradhāyati.
mn37:8.6: bhūtapubbaṃ mārisa moggallāna, devāsurasaṅgāmo samupabbūḷho ahosi.
mn37:8.7: tasmiṃ kho pana mārisa moggallāna saṅgāme devā vijiniṃsu. asurā parājiniṃsu.
mn37:8.8: so kho ahaṃ mārisa moggallāna taṃ saṅgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṅgāmo tato paṭinivattitvā vejayantaṃ nāma pāsādaṃ māpesiṃ.
mn37:8.9: vejayantassa kho pana mārisa moggallāna pāsādassa niyyūhasataṃ. ekamekasmiṃ
mn37:8.13: iccheyyāsi no tvaṃ mārisa moggallāna vejayantassa pāsādassa rāmaṇeyyakaṃ daṭṭhunti.
mn37:8.14: adhivāsesi kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno tuṇhī bhāvena.
mn37:9.1: athakho sakko ca devānamindo vessavaṇo ca mahārājā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ purakkhatvā yena vejayanto pāsādo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
mn37:9.2: addasaṃsu kho sakkassa devānamindassa paricārikāyo āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
mn37:9.3: disvāna ottappamānā hirīyamānā sakasakaṃ ovarakaṃ pavisiṃsu.
mn37:10.1: seyyathāpi nāma suṇisā sasuraṃ disvā ottappati hirīyati,
mn37:10.2: evamevaṃ sakkassa devānamindassa paricārikāyo āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ disvā ottappamānā hirīyamānā sakasakaṃ ovarakaṃ pavisiṃsu.
mn37:10.3: atha kho sakko ca devānamindo vessavaṇo ca mahārājā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ vejayante pāsāde anucaṅkamāpenti anuvicarāpenti:
mn37:10.4: idampi mārisa moggallāna passa vejayantassa pāsādassa rāmaṇeyyakaṃ,
mn37:10.5: idampi mārisa moggallāna passa vejayantassa pāsādassa rāmaṇeyyakanti.
mn37:10.9: tayidaṃ āyasmato kosiyassa sobhati yathā taṃ pubbe katapuññassāti.
mn37:11.2: atibāḷhaṃ kho ayaṃ yakkho pamatto viharati.
mn37:11.4: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṃkhāsi yathā vejayantaṃ pāsādaṃ pādaṅguṭṭhakena saṅkampesi sampakampesi sampavedhesi.
mn37:11.5: atha kho sakko ca devānamindo vessavaṇo ca mahārājā devā ca tāvatiṃsā acchariyabbhutacittā ahesuṃ:
mn37:11.6: acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho,
mn37:11.7: samaṇassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā, yatra hi nāma dibbaṃ bhavanaṃ pādaṅguṭṭhakena saṅkampessati sampakampessati sampavedhessatīti.
mn37:12.1: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ saṃviggaṃ lomahaṭṭhajātaṃ viditvā sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ etadavoca:
mn37:12.2: “yathākathaṃ pana te kosiya bhagavā saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiṃ abhāsi?
mn37:12.3: sādhu. mayampi etissā kathāya bhāgino assāma savaṇāyā”ti.
mn37:12.4: “idhāhaṃ mārisa moggallāna, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsiṃ. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho ahaṃ mārisa moggallāna bhagavantaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn37:12.5: kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhu saṅkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti accantaniṭṭho accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānanti.
mn37:13.1: evaṃ vutte mārisa moggallāna bhagavā maṃ etadavoca: –
mn37:13.6: so sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānāti. sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya sabbaṃ dhammaṃ parijānāti. sabbaṃ dhammaṃ pariññāya yaṃ kiñci vedanaṃ vedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā,
mn37:13.7: so tāsu vedanāsu aniccānupassī viharati, virāgānupassī viharati, nirodhānupassī viharati, paṭinissaggānupassī viharati.
mn37:13.8: so tāsu vedanāsu aniccānupassī viharanto, virāgānupassī viharanto, nirodhānupassī viharanto, paṭinissaggānupassī viharanto na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
mn37:13.9: anupādiyaṃ na paritassati. aparitassaṃ paccattaññeva parinibbāyati.
mn37:13.10: ‘khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāti.
mn37:13.11: ettāvatā kho devānaminda bhikkhu saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti accantaniṭṭho accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānanti.’
mn37:13.12: evaṃ kho me mārisa moggallāna bhagavā saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiṃ abhāsī”ti.
mn37:14.1: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno sakkassa devānamindassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evameva devesu tāvatiṃsesu antarahito pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde pāturahosi.
mn37:14.2: atha kho sakkassa devānamindassa paricārikāyo acirapakkante āyasmante mahāmoggallāne sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ etadavocuṃ:
mn37:14.3: eso nu kho te mārisa so bhagavā satthāti.
mn37:14.4: na kho me mārisā so bhagavā satthā,
mn37:14.8: aho nūna te so bhagavā satthāti.
mn37:15.1: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhagavantaṃ etadavoca: –
mn37:15.2: “abhijānāti no bhante bhagavā ahu ñātaññatarassa mahesakkhassa yakkhassa saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiṃ bhāsitā”.
mn37:15.3: “abhijānāmahaṃ moggallāna: idha sakko devānamindo yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho moggallāna sakko devānamindo maṃ etadavoca:
mn37:15.4: kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhu saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti accantaniṭṭho accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānanti.
mn37:15.5: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ moggallāna sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn37:15.10: so sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānāti, sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya sabbaṃ dhammaṃ parijānāti. sabbaṃ dhammaṃ pariññāya yaṃ kiñci vedanaṃ vedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā.
mn37:15.11: so tāsu vedanāsu aniccānupassī viharati, virāgānupassī viharati, nirodhānupassī viharati, paṭinissaggānupassī viharati.
mn37:15.12: so tāsu vedanāsu aniccānupassī viharanto, virāgānupassī viharanto, nirodhānupassī viharanto,
mn37:15.13: paṭinissaggānupassī viharanto na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
mn37:15.14: anupādiyaṃ na paritassati. aparitassaṃ paccattaññeva parinibbāyati.
mn37:15.15: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāti.
mn37:15.16: ettāvatā kho devānaminda bhikkhu saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti accantaniṭṭho accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānanti.
mn37:15.17: evaṃ kho ahaṃ moggallāna abhijānāmi sakkassa devānamindassa saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiṃ bhāsitā”ti.
mn37:15.19: attamano āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
